# Doorbell (`doorbell`)

A ring that takes over the screen: live picture, who rang and when, and Answer, Talk and Dismiss.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createDoorbell` (types in `dist/web/home/security/doorbell.d.ts`): `.mh-doorbell`: a ring that asks for attention. `role="alertdialog"` named by the `__title` (who rang) and described by the `__detail` (door and when); a `__header` with the ringing `__bell`, then the `__picture` (`__placeholder` under a live `__image` refreshed off-screen like the camera tile) and the `__actions`: Answer, Talk (a toggle, `aria-pressed`) and Dismiss (End once answered). With `takeover` it covers the screen (`--takeover`, `aria-modal`), keeps Tab inside and dismisses on Escape; call `focus()` once it is on screen. States `.is-ringing` (until answered), `.is-answered`, `.is-talking`, `.is-empty` without a picture.

```ts
export function createDoorbell(options: DoorbellOptions): DoorbellHandle;

export interface DoorbellOptions {
  /** The door or doorbell ("Front door"). */
  door: string;
  /** Who rang, when the app knows ("Parcel delivery"); else the default title. */
  visitor?: string | null;
  /** When it rang, as the app words it ("Just now", "10:42"). */
  when?: string | null;
  /** The live picture: any image URL, or null. */
  src?: string | null;
  /** Reloads the picture every this many seconds while it is visible (default 1). 0 for a still. */
  refreshEvery?: number | null;
  /** Width / height of the picture (default 4 / 3). */
  aspect?: number;
  /** Takes over the screen: fixed over everything, focus kept inside, Escape dismisses. */
  takeover?: boolean;
  /** The bell rings (animated) until answered or dismissed (default true). */
  ringing?: boolean;
  /** The call is answered: Answer goes away, Dismiss reads "End". */
  answered?: boolean;
  /** Talking now (the Talk toggle is pressed). */
  talking?: boolean;
  /** Offer Answer (default true when `onAnswer` is given). */
  canAnswer?: boolean;
  /** Offer Talk (default true when `onTalk` is given). */
  canTalk?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<DoorbellLabels>;
  onAnswer?: () => void;
  /** Talk pressed: the wanted talking state. */
  onTalk?: (talking: boolean) => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

export interface DoorbellHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. */
  update(changes: Partial<DoorbellOptions>): void;
  /** Moves focus to the first action (Answer when offered). */
  focus(): void;
  /** Stops refreshing the picture. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface DoorbellLabels {
  /** The heading when the app doesn't know who rang. */
  title: string;
  answer: string;
  talk: string;
  dismiss: string;
  /** The dismiss button once answered. */
  end: string;
  /** Alternative text of the picture: `{door}` is replaced by the door's name. */
  picture: string;
  /** Shown when there is no picture. */
  noPicture: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createDoorbell, type DoorbellHandle } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let bell: DoorbellHandle | null = null;

const close = () => {
  bell?.destroy();
  bell?.el.remove();
  bell = null;
  ring.el.focus();
};

// In an app this runs when the doorbell rings.
const ring = createButton({
  label: 'Ring the doorbell',
  icon: 'bell',
  onClick: () => {
    const handle = createDoorbell({
      door: 'Front door',
      visitor: 'Parcel delivery',
      when: 'Just now',
      src: '/snapshots/front-door.jpg',
      // Covers the screen, keeps focus inside and closes with Escape.
      takeover: true,
      onAnswer: () => handle.update({ answered: true }),
      onTalk: (talking) => handle.update({ talking }),
      onDismiss: close,
    });
    bell = handle;
    document.body.append(handle.el);
    handle.focus();
  },
});

document.body.append(ring.el);
```

export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

`Doorbell` (types in `dist/react/home-security.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createDoorbell`. A takeover takes focus when it mounts.

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Doorbell } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function DoorbellExample() {
  const [ringing, setRinging] = useState(false);
  const [answered, setAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [talking, setTalking] = useState(false);
  const close = () => {
    setRinging(false);
    setAnswered(false);
    setTalking(false);
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* In an app this happens when the doorbell rings. */}
      <Button icon="bell" onClick={() => setRinging(true)}>
        Ring the doorbell
      </Button>
      {ringing && (
        <Doorbell
          door="Front door"
          visitor="Parcel delivery"
          when="Just now"
          src="/snapshots/front-door.jpg"
          takeover
          answered={answered}
          talking={talking}
          onAnswer={() => setAnswered(true)}
          onTalk={setTalking}
          onDismiss={close}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
